theme_and_archetype.reasoning: For a school admission platform for Indian parents, trust and calm are paramount due to the stressful nature of admissions. Organic & Earthy provides a grounded, trustworthy foundation, while Pastel & Soft ensures the UI feels approachable, modern, and child-adjacent without being overly childish.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase with wide tracking.
Do not center paragraphs; stick to left alignment for readability.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind default extended (p-6, p-8, p-12 for generous whitespace)

grid_strategy.landing_page: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetric, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with gap-8 to gap-12. Avoid standard 50/50 splits.
grid_strategy.dashboard: Mode B: Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Dense but readable, bento-box style.

surfaces: Dashboard Cards: Flat background (bg-white), crisp 1px border (border-gray-200), rounded-2xl. No heavy shadows by default.
Sticky Navs: Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with a 1px border-b border-gray-200/50.
Hover States: Subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and ambient shadow (shadow-lg) for interactive cards.
container_rules: Images must be constrained to max-h-[80vh] on mobile.
Grid children must be direct children of the grid container.
Always add internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to elements with borders to prevent text collision.

components.navigation: Sticky top nav with Logo, Links, and Google Login CTA. Glassmorphic background.
components.landing_hero: Split aesthetic: Large expressive typography on the left, organic overlapping image cards on the right. Image overlay maximum bg-black/30.
components.school_cards: Bento-style horizontal or vertical cards showing Image, Rating, Distance, Key Facilities (Icons), and Status.
components.dashboard_tracker: Vertical or horizontal progress stepper (Enquiry -> Form -> Interview -> Offer) using Recharts or custom SVG.
components.forms: Strictly use Shadcn components (Input, Select, Form, Checkbox, Calendar) with customized rounded-xl borders and focus:ring-accent-primary.
components.icons: Use lucide-react for all general icons, keep stroke-width consistent (1.5 or 2).
components.modals_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for quick actions (Upload Document, Schedule Interview) to prevent page navigation.
components.testing_attributes: All interactive elements must include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-button').

motion_and_interaction.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform duration-200 ease-out) rather than transition-all.
motion_and_interaction.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items (schools list, dashboard feed).
motion_and_interaction.hover: Explicitly set hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-gray-900 hover:text-white). Focus states must have higher contrast.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: Use a slow organic marquee for school logos or facilities across the landing page, using low contrast backgrounds.

rules: Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided images below.
Use object-cover for all images to maintain aspect ratio.
Add lazy loading to below-the-fold images.

landing_hero.description: Sunlight streams into a modern classroom. Use for hero background or main feature.

parents_dashboard_hero.description: Happy Indian child. Use for dashboard welcome banner or testimonial section.

school_campus_1.description: Large white building on a green field. Use for school listing thumbnail.

school_campus_2.description: Red brick building with arches. Use for school listing thumbnail.

abstract_background.description: Abstract fluid pastel shapes. Use for section backgrounds, auth screens, or dashboard blank states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic Tailwind blue/indigo.
Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body. Install via Google Fonts.
In the Parent Dashboard, prioritize narrative over complex charts. Tell the parent exactly what is pending (e.g., 'Upload Aarav\'s Birth Certificate').
All cards must have `rounded-2xl` and a subtle 1px border. Do not rely heavily on drop shadows.
Implement real working Shadcn UI components for tabs, dropdowns, and dialogs. Ensure they are fully accessible.
Ensure generous padding throughout (p-6, p-8) for a clean, premium 'bento' grid feel.
